import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    allowed_species = ['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo']
    df = df[df['species'].isin(allowed_species)]
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['penguin_id'], keep='first')
    return df

def answer(df):
    return df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
